info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Discounts-v5-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Discounts API provides access to discount information on retail orders, allowing businesses to optimize pricing strategies and promotions. This GET operation returns a comprehensive list of discounts applicable to various retail orders, enabling users to gain insights into discount distributions and market trends. It is particularly useful for developers working in retail and e-commerce sectors who need to analyze discount patterns or implement dynamic pricing features. Enhance your business intelligence and customer engagement through effective discount management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all applicable discounts that can be applied to orders, providing you with the necessary information to optimize pricing and promotions for customers.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve discounts for orders. It should contain relevant details that specify the criteria for fetching the discounts applicable to orders.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current discount information.

ListRetailOrdersDiscountsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving discount information related to orders. The value should be a JSON string that includes specific discount details.
